basic_info.description: Price reduced! Rare find. Trustee sale.  This vacant Edwardian duplex fixer upper located on the sunny side of Anza has great bones for modernization.  Come discover this charming vacant two unit building right in the heart of Central Richmond district.  One of the rare homes in the city with both a front yard and a back yard that is connected by a side alley.  Both units have separate entrances and each are full floor flats with nearly identical floor plans consisting of two bedrooms, one full bathroom with shower over tub, kitchen plus dining room, utility room, and a bright and spacious living room that has potential to be a third bedroom. The upper unit has new paint, new luxury vinyl plank flooring, new hood and appliances. The large flat backyard is perfect for entertaining.  The staircase in the backyard was recently built.  Great opportunity to live in one flat while collecting rental income from the other unit or can be a family compound.  Situated in a prime location just around the corner from Argonne Playground, Starbucks, all major banks and a multitude of restaurants, shops and markets.  You may not afford the price tag for 2840 Broadway, but 2840 Anza can be had for $69M less. Listing agent is a beneficiary of the trust.
